input:
You are king_e1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 36. the team planned Kf2 (king_e1), but king_e1 (amnesia) sent Kh2 instead, and that move was played, costing 8 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 8. the team planned Bxb8 (bishop_c1), but pawn_c2 (greed) sent cxd5 instead, and that move was played, costing 160 centipawns.
- On move 15. the team planned Be4 (bishop_f1), but bishop_f1 (amnesia) sent Ba8 instead, and that move was played, costing 252 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Only the piece named in the team's agreed plan may send a move this turn, and it must send exactly that planned move, so no other piece captures, flees, or substitutes a different move unless the plan's piece has not moved after the team explicitly calls for a fallback in chat.
- Before sending any move, an agent must re-read the plan in chat and send only if its own piece and the exact move (piece and destination square) match the plan; if its piece is not the planned one, or it is threatened or sees a capture, it stays silent and posts its concern in chat instead.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Before sending, an agent must copy the planned move's piece and destination square from the latest plan message into its own pre-send chat post (e.g. 'Sending Kf2 from king_e1'), and send only the exact move it just quoted; if it cannot quote its own piece and square from the plan, or its move differs from the quoted one, it must send nothing.", "covers": ["amnesia", "greed", "panic"]}
